A. the rapid increase in the price of oil
B. the public relations efforts of alternative energy advocates
C. the large amount of waste oil from deep fryers

E. the improvement in irrigation techniques

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
